ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 75-80% high-intensity white central field against 20-25% low-intensity black perimeter and focal mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white blob across the central 70% of both lobes. Dense black pigmentation along the entire perimeter. Cluster of irregular black speckling/blobs radiating from the median notch area towards the mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 50-60 degrees relative to the lobe intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations across both trailing edges. Right lobe (pixel-right) exhibits a significant semi-circular indentation/notch approximately mid-way between the median notch and the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in acute, upward-angled distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, textured tan-white circular pixel groupings (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four distinct dark linear streaks oriented horizontally/diagonally located in the lower-mid quadrant of the right (pixel-right) fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive barnacle colonization on distal fluke tips and sections of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique black splatter pattern or 'flecking' concentrated primarily around the median notch and the proximal base of the fluke lobes.
